summary: The proof is correct and complete. The endpoint measures are absolutely continuous probabilities with bounded, compactly supported densities, so McCann's Brenier map and displacement interpolation apply. The q=infinity case of Theorem 2.3 has exponent -1/d and the stated greater-than-or-equal direction, yielding the required L-infinity domination after rescaling. Convexity of C gives the fiber support containment, compact support justifies all first-moment and barycenter identities, positive s is preserved under interpolation, and the closure of the convex generator is convex.
